title: AI Ethics, Fairness and Governance
overview: Understand the social impacts of AI, how bias arises, how fairness is measured, and how organizations govern AI use.
objectives: Identify sources of bias in data and models
Describe governance practices such as impact assessments and documentation

method.title: Sources of bias
method.body: Bias can enter through unrepresentative data, label choices, proxy features, and deployment context.

method.title: Fairness metrics
method.body: Demographic parity compares positive rates across groups; other criteria compare error rates, and they can conflict.

method.title: Governance
method.body: Practices include risk assessment, model and data documentation, human oversight, auditing, and incident response.

method.title: Regulation and privacy
method.body: Laws and standards increasingly require transparency, data protection, and risk-based controls for AI uses.

quiz.question: Fairness criteria:
options: Can sometimes conflict with each other
